component.name: ProjectLibre
component.summary: Plan projects with Gantt charts, tasks and resources

description.p: ProjectLibre is desktop project management software for planning tasks, dependencies, schedules, resources and costs. View your project as a Gantt chart, network diagram or work breakdown structure, and open Microsoft Project files.
This community package installs the official ProjectLibre Linux build unmodified, including its bundled Java runtime.
In package testing, reopening an exported Microsoft Project XML file displayed an empty task view. Use the native .pod format to save and reopen projects.

The Java file chooser can open and save files in your Documents folder. To work in another folder, grant it with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/projects com.projectlibre.ProjectLibre. Undo custom permissions with flatpak override --user --reset com.projectlibre.ProjectLibre.
Network access for optional registration and update checks is not enabled by default. Enable it with flatpak override --user --share=network com.projectlibre.ProjectLibre.
